fields.label: Assistant
fields.description: Master switch and approval behavior for every conversation on this site.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Master switch: when off, the assistant answers no chats and runs no tools.

fields.label: Approval Mode
fields.options:
Approve Every Step
Approve Writes Only
Automatic
fields.description: Approve Every Step asks before every tool call; Approve Writes Only asks only before changes; Automatic asks nothing. Every action is recorded.

fields.label: Limits
fields.description: Hard ceilings applied to every run; the server rejects out-of-range values.

fields.label: Max Steps
fields.description: Most tool calls one message may chain. Allowed: 1 to 30.

fields.label: Max Tokens
fields.description: OUTPUT token ceiling per model reply, not the context size. Allowed: 128 to 1048576.

fields.label: Max Run Seconds
fields.description: Wall-clock budget for one run. Allowed: 30 to 1800 seconds.

fields.label: Approval Expiry Minutes
fields.description: A pending approval expires after this many minutes. Allowed: 5 to 10080.

fields.label: Daily Run Limit
fields.description: Most runs per user per day. Allowed: 1 to 10000.

fields.label: Max Upload Mb
fields.description: Largest single attachment in MB. Allowed: 1 to 20.

fields.label: Max File Chars
fields.description: Most characters read from one attached file. Allowed: 1000 to 100000.

fields.label: Scope and Tools
fields.description: What the assistant may read, write and run; values stay read-only without write permission.

fields.label: Allowed Read Doctypes
fields.description: DocTypes the read tools may search and read; blank means nothing is readable.

fields.label: Allowed Write Doctypes
fields.description: Writable subset of the readable DocTypes; ledger, workflow and submittable DocTypes are never writable.

fields.label: Enabled Tools
fields.description: Reviewed tools the assistant may call; blank disables every tool.

fields.label: Allowed Reports
fields.description: Reports the run_report tool may execute; blank means none.

fields.label: Allowed Custom Hosts
fields.description: Exact hostnames custom providers may call (for example api.example.com); no URLs, ports or wildcards.
